buildProposal.decision: Implement the bounded C3 review-UX fixes: truthful replay and recorded review provenance, concise local uncertainty with inspectable evidence and meaningful search/citation labels, and explicit review-versus-brief Save with existing session-qualified return and pending status.
buildProposal.scope: Build permission under the adopted standing development policy for a bounded C3 UI and regression-test sprint, not a redesign. Preserve stored review actors/timestamps/actions and original reasons without inferring authorship; keep unknown origin unknown and Historical replay visually distinct. Retain local uncertainty/status and evidence dates while expanding repetitive detail; literal local search covers meaningful statement/scope/source material, and citation labels use existing identifiers with complete evidence inspectable. Explain separate information-review and brief Save, preflight missing evidence/firsthand basis, retain cancel/refusal reasoning, and render account-qualified working-brief return and pending/saved status only from existing server-session state. No autosave, durable schema, trust designation, quota, source/generation identity or as-saved history changes. Includes relevant offline tests, exact-head independent technical review, disposable retained-account browser checks, authorized subscription GLM simulated-user/native-image reviews, documentation and ordinary PR/CI/merge. No product model generation, source acquisition, original retained-data mutation, production deployment, public ingress, external sends, new private-data scope, paid fallback, budget reset or customer acceptance. Engineering review use grants no product effect. Existing scope, budgets, raw-response identity, source custody, persistence and approval boundaries remain unchanged. Proposal stays agent-proposed and does not impersonate Andrew or ratify product content.
